headline: Frontline Casualties Surge as Bases Change Hands
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the grinding has sharpened on the principal theatres. Nevish Line erupted with 1,516 Colonial and 1,906 Warden dead in the past two hours and ten base events, pushing its 24‑hour tally to 59 ownership changes. Linn Mercy followed suit, recording 1,245 Colonial and 1,889 Warden losses and four fresh events, bringing its day‑long churn to 40. Weathered Expanse, though quiet in the last two hours, has accumulated 43 base shifts over the day amid 268 Colonial and 193 Warden casualties. Callahans Passage remains a blood‑soaked corridor, adding 1,312 Colonial and 1,242 Warden dead with two new events and 16 total changes. Mooring County’s grind accelerated to 1,778 Colonial and 1,443 Warden losses, also logging 16 daily events. Marban Hollow, previously dormant, produced 60 Colonial and 87 Warden casualties and 11 base turnovers. Enlistments are climbing across all hot zones, feeding fresh manpower into the grinder, while the majority of sectors report no events and steady, low casualty counts.
